name: my-marketplace
description: Local marketplace — personal overlay on the AIDD framework

plugins.name: overcode
plugins.description: Extends AIDD with project-agnostic workflows: research and multi-session PDF extraction; interactive codebase and project-memory quizzes (dig); memory maintenance; repository-backed Markdown freshness and AIDD-evidenced product/code sobriety (taste); target-aware resilience scenarios plus dependency abandonment and migration horizon (foresee); behavioural testing; test governance; performance, data, ActivityPub, and SEO/GEO audits; project health and repository-backed Markdown backlog synchronization via status; plain-language explanations; documentation; and planning utilities. Stack and service knowledge remains pivot-driven through specialist plugins, and AIDD delegation fails explicitly when a required capability is unavailable. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision.

plugins.name: design

plugins.name: obs
plugins.description: Personal Obsidian notes management, driven by deterministic Python scripts (no model call): the Documents/ organiser tree (cache-based index, check, fix, sort, destinations); filler (survey, sort, index, merge, clean); project (create, invoice, export-rag); mail (rules-based triage of exported mail).
